_notes: Sensirion SCD30 CO2/temperature/humidity at 0x61 (SEL to GND or floating for I2C: SEL high at power-up selects Modbus and the sensor never answers on I2C). No detection values: 0x61 is in the RSAO identification hook's probe range, and a detection that could fail would let the hook send it framed bytes (as the STCC4, devdocs/stcc4-identification-notes.md). Not scanned while polled (scanWhilePolled false): a scanner presence probe stops it producing data (data-ready never set while probed every few seconds); its polls show it's there. Init: firmware version (0xD100), read the measurement interval (0x4600), start continuous measurement with no pressure compensation (0x0010 0x0000), then set the interval to 2 s only if it differs ({?setInterval}, computed by initCode) as it's stored in non-volatile memory. ASC is left as stored (the autoCal action sets it). Commands are followed by a pause before the read (the SCD30 needs 3 ms). Poll (every 3 s, longer than the 2 s measurement): data-ready (0x0202) twice, then read measurement (0x0300): CO2, T and RH as big-endian floats, each 2-byte half followed by a CRC. Decode: a sample only when the second data-ready word is 1 (a read before data is ready gives 0xFFFF words), with the floats built from their bits. Rates (_conf.rate) only set the poll interval, 3 s to 60 s. Actions (each stored in non-volatile memory): autoCal (automatic self-calibration, 1 on, 0 off), forceCal (forced recalibration to a reference ppm - run in that concentration for at least 2 minutes first), tempOffset (degrees C, subtracted from the temperature), altitude (m); pressure restarts measurement with ambient pressure compensation (mbar, 0 off); softReset.

c.c: int ready=(buf[3]<<8)|buf[4];if(ready==1){int co2h=(buf[6]<<8)|buf[7];int co2l=(buf[9]<<8)|buf[10];int co2e=(co2h>>7)&255;float co2=0.0;if(co2e>0){if(co2e<255){co2=1.0+(((co2h&127)*65536)+co2l)/8388608.0;int co2k=co2e-127;while(co2k>0){co2=co2*2.0;co2k=co2k-1;}while(co2k<0){co2=co2/2.0;co2k=co2k+1;}}}if(co2h>32767){co2=0.0-co2;}out.CO2=co2;int tmph=(buf[12]<<8)|buf[13];int tmpl=(buf[15]<<8)|buf[16];int tmpe=(tmph>>7)&255;float tmp=0.0;if(tmpe>0){if(tmpe<255){tmp=1.0+(((tmph&127)*65536)+tmpl)/8388608.0;int tmpk=tmpe-127;while(tmpk>0){tmp=tmp*2.0;tmpk=tmpk-1;}while(tmpk<0){tmp=tmp/2.0;tmpk=tmpk+1;}}}if(tmph>32767){tmp=0.0-tmp;}out.temperature=tmp;int humh=(buf[18]<<8)|buf[19];int huml=(buf[21]<<8)|buf[22];int hume=(humh>>7)&255;float hum=0.0;if(hume>0){if(hume<255){hum=1.0+(((humh&127)*65536)+huml)/8388608.0;int humk=hume-127;while(humk>0){hum=hum*2.0;humk=humk-1;}while(humk<0){hum=hum/2.0;humk=humk+1;}}}if(humh>32767){hum=0.0-hum;}out.humidity=hum;next;}

actions.desc: Sample rate (Hz) - how often the 2 s measurements are read
Automatic self-calibration: 1 on, 0 off (needs regular fresh air, about 1 hour a day; the first correction comes after about 7 days)
Forced recalibration to this CO2 (ppm): measure in that concentration for at least 2 minutes first
Temperature offset (C) for self-heating, subtracted from the temperature
Ambient pressure compensation (mbar, 700-1400; 0 off) - restarts continuous measurement
Soft reset (measurement restarts with the stored settings)
